subject: Pilot wrap + KPI recap — quick 1-line quote or 10m sync?
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@novafashion.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novafashion.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap + KPI recap — quick 1-line quote or 10m sync?

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for running the three-week pilot with Redwood. We pulled together a short recap and a few clean metrics we think will be useful if you’re open to a one-line endorsement or a quick 10-minute call to approve a short quote for our site. No pressure — total ask is a 1–2 sentence quote or a 10-minute sync.

High-level outcomes (72-hour steady-state window / production-like traffic):
- Median inference latency down ~42% (230ms -> 134ms) after batching + KV cache tuning
- Peak throughput increased ~2.8x under the same GPU pool (smoother tail latencies)
- Token cost per inference reduced ~27% due to intelligent batching + cache hits
- 99.6% success rate on API requests (3xx/4xx/5xx combined < 0.5%)
- Integration and model pinning completed in < 2 weeks (incl. private VPC config)

Attachments: novafashion-pilot-report.pdf (full results), novafashion-kpi-snapshot.png (one-pager).

If you’re comfortable, a single sentence like the example below would be great for a short case blurb — otherwise we can hop on a 10-minute call:

Suggested 1-line (editable): “Redwood reduced our inference latency by over 40% and made scaling predictable without touching our model stack.”

Proposed short windows (PST): Wed Aug 6 10:00–11:00 or Thu Aug 7 14:00–15:00. If those don’t work, reply with a time that does.

If we get a quick approval I’ll route the blurb through legal/marketing for final publish permission and keep it tightly attributed (title + company only). Thanks again for the partnership — this pilot moved much faster than we expected.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127

Attachment: novafashion-pilot-report.pdf (15 pages)
Attachment: novafashion-kpi-snapshot.png
From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@novafashion.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novafashion.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap + KPI recap — quick 1-line quote or 10m sync?

Stephanie — thanks for this and for the clear summary. The team is pleased with the latency improvements and the lower cost run-rate. A quick one-liner is fine; I drafted a short version below.

One-liner (ok to edit): “Redwood cut our inference latency by more than 40% and eliminated the surprise spikes we were seeing in production.”

I do have a quick question on retention: in the report the cache-hit assumptions reference a 7-day prefix window — can you confirm what data (if any) Redwood retains in the pilot environment vs our production config? Not blocking the quote, just want to be sure we understand the retention policy before publicizing any numbers.

I can do a 10-minute call Thu Aug 7 at 14:15 PST if that works for you.

— Alex
Alex Garcia
Head of ML Systems, NovaFashion
alex.garcia@novafashion.com | +1 415-777-2244

Attachment: latency-sample-1.csv (sample logs)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@novafashion.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novafashion.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap + KPI recap — quick 1-line quote or 10m sync?

Hi Alex — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the great line. That wording works well (we may make a very small edit for flow) — would you be comfortable if we attribute it to “Alex Garcia, Head of ML Systems, NovaFashion”? If so, I’ll proceed to marketing for a short snippet and legal for final sign-off.

To your question: for the pilot we ran caching in a sandboxed mode only — Redwood did not retain customer request payloads beyond standard telemetry (latency/error stats and anonymized cache hit rates). I’ve asked our security team to confirm the exact retention time for telemetry logs (should be 30 days by default) and will share that confirmation in the call.

I booked the 14:15 PST slot Thu Aug 7 and attached a calendar invite (calendar-invite-10min.ics). If you want the one-liner tweaked slightly, here is a tightened version we sometimes use:

Edited suggestion: “Redwood reduced our inference latency by over 40% and made scaling predictable for production traffic.”

If that looks good, please reply with a thumbs-up or the final small edit and I’ll queue it.

Thanks — looking forward to the quick sync.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
